name: Weekly report
description: Summarizes what trended, what converted, and what to double down on for the past week, using morning-scan history, script approvals, catalog-sync results, and commerce engine order/analytics data.
steps: Aggregate the past 7 days of morning-scan trend results and note recurring dishes/creators/hooks.
Pull order and analytics data from the commerce engine for products created during the period.
Compute conversion signals: views -> shop taps -> orders per product draft that was approved and published.
Identify the top 3 trends that converted best and the top 3 that fizzled.
Draft 'double down on' recommendations for the coming week (menu items to feature, hooks to reuse, creators to collaborate with).
Send the report through the notifications connector; do not take any further action without a new approval.
